scope: status: board pills, live-status lines and keyword glossary words. chip: skill/ability marks on the card face (abilityBadges, CHIP_FALLBACK_SKILLS, trigger chips). fx: tint classes, overlays, decorative plates/wings/light and battlefield states on a board card. Transient hit/skill animations (renderVfxForEvent and the fx files) are not listed: they are one-off events, not states.

entries.name: Poison
entries.meaning: Its hits add N Poison.

entries.name: Explode
entries.meaning: After its timer runs down it explodes once, hitting the enemy facing it (or the bramble).

entries.name: Armor
entries.meaning: Takes N less damage from every hit.

entries.name: Thorns
entries.meaning: Melee attackers take N damage.

entries.name: Evasive
entries.meaning: Dodges half of all single-target attacks and skills.

entries.name: N
entries.meaning: The first time it dies, it dies in full, then comes back with 1 Health and no statuses.

entries.name: Tide
entries.meaning: Flood: +1 Attack. Ebb: +1 Armor.

entries.name: Swimmer
entries.meaning: On Tide, +1 Attack, +1 Attack. On Ebb, +1 Armor.

entries.name: Rainmaker
entries.meaning: When played, Spring Rain falls for 3 rounds (every unit heals 2 a round).

entries.name: Rainrunner
entries.meaning: In rain: +N/+N, and it can't be blocked.

entries.name: Moonborn
entries.meaning: At night: up to +N/+N, depending on the moon's phase.

entries.name: Frostbite
entries.meaning: Each time frost chills it, it gains +N/+N for good.

entries.name: Esprit
entries.meaning: +0/+0 whenever another of your Kin enters play.

entries.name: Nature's Force
entries.meaning: Your Elementals get +1/+1.

entries.name: Crepuscular
entries.meaning: At Twilight: +0/+0. With it in your deck, every fifth phase is Twilight.

entries.name: Sun-shy
entries.meaning: Blind by day.

entries.name: Night-blind
entries.meaning: Blind at night, unless an Illuminate unit lights your side (or faces it).

entries.name: Shedding
entries.meaning: Every 3 rounds: +1/+1 for good, and it sheds its Poison, Bleed, Corrode, Scar and Exposed.

entries.name: Molting
entries.meaning: Every 2 rounds: +1/+1 for good, but +1 Wait.

entries.name: Dynamite
entries.meaning: A 3-upkeep fuse; at 0 it blows: 5 fire damage beside it and to the 3 foes facing it.

entries.name: Helmet
entries.meaning: Half the arrows, missiles and bolts aimed at it glance off.

entries.name: Bludgeon
entries.meaning: Its hits take 1 Attack and knock out one of the target's skills.

entries.name: Snipe
entries.meaning: While Ready, if nothing faces it, shoot a random enemy unit for 1 every upkeep.

entries.name: Kinship
entries.meaning: All your units of its chosen type get +X/+Y (itself too). Stacks.

entries.name: Rocket
entries.meaning: Once, when Ready: 1 fire damage to the strongest enemy and 1 to its neighbours (or the bramble).

entries.name: Lone Wolf
entries.meaning: +0/+0 for each empty slot within 2 of it, and +0/+0 more when all 4 are empty.

entries.name: Sociable
entries.meaning: +0/+0 for each ally within 2 slots of it, and +0/+0 more when all 4 are filled.

entries.name: Coffee
entries.meaning: When played, Wait −1. 1 round later it naps: Stunned for a round.

entries.name: Dry
entries.meaning: Takes half fire damage, and Scorching days can't touch it.

entries.name: Darksight
entries.meaning: It can see in darkness.

entries.name: Cast Darkness
entries.meaning: On Play: Darkness falls on the field while it lives.

entries.name: True Strike
entries.meaning: Its attacks never miss.

entries.name: Illuminate
entries.meaning: Lights up the dark: your units don't miss in darkness, and nor does the enemy unit facing it.

entries.name: Nursing
entries.meaning: Heal your weakest wounded unit for 2 every upkeep.

entries.name: Landslide
entries.meaning: When it dies, deal 1 damage to the enemy facing it and the enemies beside that one (not Flying).

entries.name: Inspiring
entries.meaning: When it attacks, adjacent allies get +N Attack on their next attack.

entries.name: Friction
entries.meaning: When it attacks, deal N damage to adjacent allies.

entries.name: Lumberjack
entries.meaning: Whenever you gain Lumber, gain 1 more.

entries.name: Heavy Metal
entries.meaning: Whenever you gain Stone or Metal, gain 1 more.

entries.name: Timber
entries.meaning: +1/+1 for each Lumber you hold.

entries.name: Rock-solid
entries.meaning: +2/+2 for each Stone you hold.

entries.name: Iron-will
entries.meaning: +3/+3 for each Metal you hold.

entries.name: Loyal
entries.meaning: While one of your leaders is on the field: +0/+0.

entries.name: Usurper
entries.meaning: While the enemy leader is on the field: +0/+0.

entries.name: Shell
entries.meaning: When first hit: +N Armor and +N Health until next round ends, but it can't attack then.

entries.name: Pitchfork
entries.meaning: One four-pronged swing, aimed left or right at random: half Attack on each of 4 neighbouring columns.

entries.name: Trident
entries.meaning: One three-pronged swing straight ahead: full Attack in front, half to the units on its left and right.

entries.name: Octolash
entries.meaning: Hits the 8 nearest enemy units with full Attack.

entries.name: Speed
entries.meaning: Speed N: faster units swing first.

entries.name: Haste
entries.meaning: Speed +2, and +1 to adjacent allies.

entries.name: Rabid
entries.meaning: Its hits add 2 Poison. Swimmers and water damage hit it for double.

entries.name: Cower
entries.meaning: Hit last turn: it hides in its shell this turn (no attack, attacks can't hurt it).

entries.name: Ghost
entries.meaning: Normal attacks pass through it; other elements deal half, magic full. It can't Bleed.

entries.name: Ichor
entries.meaning: Whoever hits it takes N acid damage, loses 1 Armor and Bleeds 1.

entries.name: Irradiated
entries.meaning: Every upkeep: gives N Irradiation to adjacent units and the enemy facing it, and 1 to itself.

entries.name: Shade
entries.meaning: At night or in darkness: half damage from non-magic attacks.

entries.name: Shadow
entries.meaning: At night or in darkness: attacks at it miss 1 in 2 (not magic).

entries.name: Supreme
entries.meaning: Its attacks are magic and crush Armor, shields and Ward. Takes half from non-magic damage.

entries.name: Twin
entries.meaning: When it arrives, a twin token of it appears beside it.

entries.name: Sprout
entries.meaning: When it arrives, a 1/3 Growth Sprout sprouts beside it.

entries.name: Growth
entries.meaning: Counts toward every ally's Swarm.

entries.name: Moonpull
entries.meaning: When it arrives, the Tide comes in.

entries.name: Bloom When
entries.meaning: In bloom 🌸 while its conditions hold: it has the bonus.

entries.name: Wave
entries.meaning: Hits push the target 1 column either way; crashing into a unit deals 1 to both.

entries.name: Brood
entries.meaning: When it arrives, a 1/1 Brood token of its kind (Swarm) hatches beside it.

entries.name: Supreme Tide
entries.meaning: A Tide unit: +2 Attack and +2 Armor every round, Flood or Ebb. Tide effects can't take them away.

entries.name: Crab Claws
entries.meaning: Pinches a random enemy to its left or right, never the one in front; with none, the bramble.

entries.name: Meiosis
entries.meaning: When it dies, it splits into 2 halves: half the stats and skill numbers, no Meiosis.

entries.name: Nullify
entries.meaning: Its hits trigger no reactions. Units it kills skip their death effects and go to the N.

entries.name: Restless
entries.meaning: Every upkeep it steps one column toward the nearest enemy.

entries.name: Charge
entries.meaning: Once Ready, a clock counts down each upkeep; at 0 its effect happens and the clock restarts.

entries.name: Tornado
entries.meaning: When it arrives, a random enemy unit is flung to another column for 1 damage (2 for flyers).

entries.name: Avalanche
entries.meaning: When it arrives, every enemy unit without Flying takes N cold damage and +1 Wait.

entries.name: Tsunami
entries.meaning: When it arrives, every enemy unit gets +1 Wait; non-swimmers take N water damage. Starts the Tide.

entries.name: Dragon Lightning
entries.meaning: Its hits call red lightning: N damage to the target and a unit beside it, ignoring Armor.

entries.name: Wither
entries.meaning: Its hits wither: -N max Health a round for 3 rounds, and no healing meanwhile.

entries.name: Egg
entries.meaning: cracks open into a random N card when Ready

entries.name: Fencing
entries.meaning: Its attacks can't be dodged by Evasive or Swift units.

entries.name: Fireball
entries.meaning: When Ready: a fireball hits a random enemy unit and the units beside it for 15 fire damage each.

entries.name: Meteor
entries.meaning: When Ready: a meteor hits a random enemy column for 20 (5 beside it); the crater burns 2 rounds.

entries.name: Banana
entries.meaning: Each round, last: eats its banana (+3 Health, if hurt) or throws it at a random enemy (3 damage).

entries.name: Bananarang
entries.meaning: A Boomerang that may be eaten when it comes home (+3 Health, 1 in 2, only if hurt).

entries.name: Durian
entries.meaning: Every round, last: 1 in 2 it eats a durian for Thorns +1 (stacks).

entries.name: Shield
entries.meaning: Arrives with 1 Shield: temporary Health that soaks damage first.

entries.name: Electricity
entries.meaning: Its hits arc to a unit beside the target for 1 lightning damage.

entries.name: Chain Lightning
entries.meaning: Its hits chain lightning on through 2 more enemy units beside the target, 2 lightning damage each.

entries.name: Keen Sense
entries.meaning: Darkness and Blind don't make it miss grounded units; it can't be Blinded.

entries.name: Psychic
entries.meaning: Its hits also deal 1 psychic damage, through Armor, Shield, Shell and Ghost. Elementals and Plants are immune.

entries.name: Smoke Bomb
entries.meaning: Each round, 1 in 2: smoke-bombs a random unit. Allies hide in Smoke; enemies are Blinded.

entries.name: Stone cost
entries.meaning: Costs N Stone to play. Stone comes from cards that quarry it

entries.name: Metal cost
entries.meaning: Costs N Metal to play

entries.name: Uranium cost
entries.meaning: Costs N Uranium to play

entries.name: Boomerang
entries.meaning: Its throw comes back next round and hits the same target again. Catch it!

entries.name: Demolisher
entries.meaning: Deals N more damage to Structures and to the enemy bramble.

entries.name: Changeling
entries.meaning: Shares a type with every unit. The enemy sees it in disguise.

entries.name: Keen Eye
entries.meaning: Sees through Changelings and hits them for 2 more.

entries.name: Primed
entries.meaning: Its triggers work even while Waiting, Stunned, Frozen or Asleep.

entries.name: Drunk
entries.meaning: Always Tipsy.

entries.name: Purblind
entries.meaning: Always Blind.

entries.name: Scatterbrained
entries.meaning: Always Confused.

entries.name: Make Tipsy
entries.meaning: Its hits can make the target Tipsy.

entries.name: Confuse
entries.meaning: Its hits can Confuse the target.

entries.name: Stampede
entries.meaning: Damage left over from a kill carries on into the enemy bramble.

entries.name: Fork
entries.meaning: Strikes the two enemies to its left and right; if either is missing, just the one in front.

entries.name: Swipe
entries.meaning: Each hit steals N Lumber.

entries.name: Twin Strike
entries.meaning: Attacks twice.

entries.name: Converge
entries.meaning: When it becomes Ready, the enemy's units close their gaps toward the centre.

entries.name: Defiance
entries.meaning: +N Attack for every enemy unit that is of its chosen type.

entries.name: Pack
entries.meaning: Pack units of its type side by side each get +1/+1 per Pack point in the chain.

entries.name: Pack Leader
entries.meaning: Links all your Pack units of its type into one chain, side by side or not, and adds +2/+2.

entries.name: Fast Forward
entries.meaning: Takes N extra turns when it arrives.

entries.name: Daunt
entries.meaning: Its hits lower the target's Attack by N until the end of next round. Stacks.

entries.name: Recoil
entries.meaning: Each attack also deals N damage to itself.

entries.name: Cleave
entries.meaning: Also deals 1 damage to the units beside its target.

entries.name: Puncture
entries.meaning: Each melee hit also deals N damage to the enemy bramble.

entries.name: Rage
entries.meaning: Below half Health: double Attack and takes half damage.

entries.name: Render
entries.meaning: When played, the enemy facing it loses 1 Attack.

entries.name: Progeny
entries.meaning: When it dies, new units take its place.

entries.name: Flying
entries.meaning: Dodges half of all attacks from units without Flying.

entries.name: Quick
entries.meaning: Swings at Speed 2: before Arrows and Bolts and units without Quick.

entries.name: Swift
entries.meaning: Always attacks first, and dodges attacks from units without Swift.

entries.name: Earthquake
entries.meaning: When played, deal N damage to every other unit without Flying, yours included.

entries.name: Amore
entries.meaning: Arriving with another of your Amore units of its Type, both fall in love: +0/+3 and Regeneration 3.

entries.name: Pounce
entries.meaning: When played: 1 damage to the foe facing it (or nearest), else the bramble.

entries.name: Bloodlust
entries.meaning: After killing the foe facing it, it leaps to the nearest enemy. Half damage to Structures and brambles.

entries.name: King Slayer
entries.meaning: Deals N more damage to Kings.

entries.name: Grace cost
entries.meaning: costs Grace to play

entries.name: Exile cost
entries.meaning: costs Exile to play

entries.name: Ice Arrow
entries.meaning: While Ready, every upkeep: shoots 2 cold damage at the foe facing it (or nearest); 1 in 2 Freezes.

entries.name: Twin Shot
entries.meaning: While Ready, shoot two random enemy units for 2 damage each every upkeep.

entries.name: Volley
entries.meaning: While Ready, every other upkeep, shoot every enemy unit for 1 damage.

entries.name: Fire Bolt
entries.meaning: While Ready, spit fire at the enemy facing it (or the nearest) for 2 fire damage every upkeep.

entries.name: Acid Bolt
entries.meaning: While Ready, every upkeep: 2 acid damage and 1 Corrode to the foe facing it (or nearest).

entries.name: Poison Bolt
entries.meaning: While Ready, spit venom at the enemy facing it (or the nearest): 2 Poison every upkeep.

entries.name: Ice Bolt
entries.meaning: While Ready, every upkeep: 2 cold damage to the foe facing it (or nearest); 1 in 2 Freezes.

entries.name: Shock Bolt
entries.meaning: While Ready, every upkeep: 2 lightning damage to the foe facing it (or nearest), and Shocks it.

entries.name: Chilli
entries.meaning: When first Ready: +2 Attack and fire attacks, but it takes 1 damage every upkeep.

entries.name: Venomous
entries.meaning: Its hits inject 2 Poison, even through Armor.

entries.name: Toxin
entries.meaning: Its hits add 1 Toxin: a poison that never wears off and can't be cured.

entries.name: Weaken
entries.meaning: Its hits take 1 Attack from the target for good.

entries.name: Wilting
entries.meaning: Each time it is hit, it loses 1 Attack for good.

entries.name: Bulldoze
entries.meaning: Its hits shove a Ready target back: +1 Wait.

entries.name: Tangleweed
entries.meaning: Its hits Bind the target: it can't attack for 1 round.

entries.name: Strangle
entries.meaning: Its hits Bind the target for a round and squeeze it for 2.

entries.name: Invincible
entries.meaning: Takes no damage for its first 1 round.

entries.name: Invisible
entries.meaning: Can't be found for its first 2 rounds, or until it attacks.

entries.name: Sonar
entries.meaning: Never misses from Darkness, Blind, Smoke or Fog, and can't be Blinded.

entries.name: Poison Gas
entries.meaning: When played, every enemy unit gets 2 Poison.

entries.name: Absolute Zero
entries.meaning: When played, every enemy unit is Frozen for the round.

entries.name: Spitfire
entries.meaning: Every upkeep while Ready: 2 fire damage to a random enemy; half the time, 1 to its neighbour.

entries.name: Slash & Burn
entries.meaning: When it kills a unit, the next enemy card played there takes 3 fire damage.

entries.name: Trap
entries.meaning: When played, trap the empty enemy slot facing it: the next card played there takes 5 damage.

entries.name: Predator
entries.meaning: Deals 1 more damage to units with less Attack.

entries.name: Prey
entries.meaning: Evasive while an enemy Predator is on the field.

entries.name: Nova
entries.meaning: When it dies, every enemy unit takes 3 magic damage.

entries.name: Crystallise
entries.meaning: When it dies, it becomes a 0/5 crystal in its slot.

entries.name: Cure
entries.meaning: Every upkeep, cure up to 2 Poison from your most poisoned unit. Poison only.

entries.name: Mountain Climber
entries.meaning: Field and terrain hazards pass it by.

entries.name: Taunt
entries.meaning: Enemies facing it or beside that column must attack it.

entries.name: Penance
entries.meaning: When played, deal 3 damage to your own bramble.

entries.name: Blood Tithe
entries.meaning: When played, deal 2 damage to a random ally (your bramble if there is none).

entries.name: Atheist
entries.meaning: Half damage from magic, Devilry and Ecclesia. Immune to the Leylines.

entries.name: Nocturnal
entries.meaning: At night: +0/+0.

entries.name: Diurnal
entries.meaning: By day: +0/+0.
entries.note: Shows as "?" until Map 1 (as itself in tutorial fights).

entries.name: Bleed
entries.meaning: Its hits add N Bleed.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.meaning: Heals N every upkeep.

entries.name: Guardian
entries.meaning: Takes the hits aimed at adjacent allies.

entries.name: Swarm
entries.meaning: +N Attack for every ally that shares a type with it.

entries.name: Arrow
entries.meaning: While Ready, shoot the enemy facing it (or the nearest) for N damage every upkeep.

entries.name: Prayer
entries.meaning: Gains 1 📿 Prayer a turn as tokens; they go if it leaves the field.

entries.name: Stealth
entries.meaning: Always attacks the enemy bramble.

entries.name: Fire Arrow
entries.meaning: While Ready, shoot the enemy facing it (or the nearest) for N fire damage every upkeep.

entries.name: Scare
entries.meaning: Attacks against it deal N less damage.

entries.name: Remember
entries.meaning: In your Removal Zone: at upkeep, spend N Echoes to return with +N/+N.

entries.name: Pierce
entries.meaning: Its melee hits ignore N Armor.

entries.name: Backstab
entries.meaning: Attacks the nearest enemy unit, never the bramble. +N damage when that unit isn't the one in front.

entries.name: Gash
entries.meaning: When played, add N Bleed to the enemy facing it.

entries.name: Ambush
entries.meaning: When an enemy unit enters the slot facing it (played, spawned or moved in), deal 3 damage to it.

entries.name: Immolation
entries.meaning: Deal N fire damage to all adjacent units every upkeep.

entries.name: Reach
entries.meaning: Flying can't dodge its attacks.

entries.name: Sacrifice
entries.meaning: A Dark Summon played onto it costs N less, and this unit perishes.

entries.name: Worship
entries.meaning: +1 Attack for every 3 Prayer you have.

entries.name: Healing
entries.meaning: Every upkeep, heal your most wounded unit for 1. It heals Health only.

entries.name: Lightning
entries.meaning: When played, deal N lightning damage to a random enemy unit, +1 for every 4 Prayer (none to a bramble: it can't be shocked).

entries.name: Expose
entries.meaning: Its hits strip the target's hiding for N rounds: Invisible, Evasive, Smoke and Shadow stop working.

entries.name: Reload
entries.meaning: After attacking, sits out N rounds.

entries.name: Stun
entries.meaning: Its hits have a 1 in 3 chance to Stun the target for 1 round.

entries.name: Siege
entries.meaning: Deals N more damage to Structures and to the enemy bramble.

entries.name: Corrode
entries.meaning: Its hits add N Corrode.

entries.name: Freeze
entries.meaning: Its hits can Freeze the target.

entries.name: Shock
entries.meaning: Its hits can Shock the target.

entries.name: Decay
entries.meaning: Its hits add N Decay.

entries.name: Counterattack
entries.meaning: Never attacks on its own. Each time an enemy hits it, it strikes the enemy facing it.

entries.name: Spiteful
entries.meaning: Deal N damage back to any enemy that damages it.

entries.name: Dictator
entries.meaning: Can only be your Leader. It never goes in your deck.

entries.name: Shield Call
entries.meaning: Once a battle, the first enemy skill aimed at one of your units hits a 0/10 Guardian shield instead.

entries.name: Midas Touch
entries.meaning: When it kills a unit, gain N Lumber.

entries.name: Retribution
entries.meaning: When one of your units dies, deal N damage to a random enemy unit.

entries.name: Well Fed
entries.meaning: At full Health, gains +N max Health every upkeep.

entries.name: Desecrate
entries.meaning: Its hits curse the ground: whoever stands there takes N damage every upkeep. Stacks.

entries.name: Crit
entries.meaning: Each round, a 1-in-2 chance to deal double damage.

entries.name: Fester
entries.meaning: Deals extra damage equal to its own Poison.

entries.name: Rupture
entries.meaning: Deals extra damage equal to its own Bleed.

entries.name: Bulwark
entries.meaning: Your bramble takes N less damage from every hit.

entries.name: Reflect
entries.meaning: Shots aimed at it (arrows, bolts, missiles, fireballs) bounce off and hit a random enemy unit.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.meaning: +N Attack every time it kills a unit.

entries.name: Bloom
entries.meaning: Heal a random wounded ally for N every upkeep.

entries.name: Frenzy
entries.meaning: While it has any status, it attacks twice and each hit adds 1 Bleed.

entries.name: Skyfall
entries.meaning: When played, deal N damage to a random enemy unit, or the bramble if there are no targets.

entries.name: Sleep
entries.meaning: Its hits can put the target to Sleep.

entries.name: Paralyze
entries.meaning: Its hits can Paralyze the target.

entries.name: Stagger
entries.meaning: Its hits can Stagger the target.

entries.name: Leech
entries.meaning: Heals for the damage its hits deal.

entries.name: Vanguard
entries.meaning: Starts in your opening hand (a random card is discarded for it). As your first card this game: +1/+1.

entries.name: Web
entries.meaning: Its hits Web the target for 1 round.

entries.name: Sentry
entries.meaning: When an enemy enters one of the 3 slots facing it, deal N damage to it.

entries.name: Carrion
entries.meaning: Whenever another unit dies, heal 2.

entries.name: Hoard
entries.meaning: +1 Attack for every 2 Lumber you hold.

entries.name: Venom Master
entries.meaning: Your units' Poison and Bleed hits add 1 more.

entries.name: Fletcher
entries.meaning: Your units' arrows deal 1 more damage.

entries.name: Herbalist
entries.meaning: Every heal on your units heals 1 more.

entries.name: Relic
entries.meaning: When it dies, leaves a 1/1 Relic in its slot with its plain keywords.

entries.name: Shatter
entries.meaning: Its hits and shots deal 2 more to Frozen, Brittle, Petrified or heavily armored units.

entries.name: Creative
entries.meaning: While Ready, give 1 Creativity to a random ally every upkeep.

entries.name: Rebuild
entries.meaning: While Ready, restore 2 Health to your bramble every upkeep.

entries.name: Harvest
entries.meaning: Half its swings harvest N Lumber instead. With nothing opposite, it always harvests.

entries.name: Scavenge
entries.meaning: When a unit dies within 1 of it, +N scavenge points. Every N points: 1 Lumber.

entries.name: Salvage
entries.meaning: When a structure dies within 1 of it, +N salvage points. Every N points: 1 Stone.

entries.name: Quarry
entries.meaning: Each turn while Ready, pay N Lumber to gain N Stone. Can't pay: nothing happens.

entries.name: Smelter
entries.meaning: Each turn while Ready, turns N Lumber and N Stone into N Metal, up to N times.

entries.name: Disarm
entries.meaning: On play, takes the enemy's nearest lying weapon; its hits take a unit's weapon. Not if it has one.

entries.name: Repair
entries.meaning: Each turn, repairs the most damaged nearby structure for N; with none, your bramble for N.

entries.name: Foraging
entries.meaning: Gathers a Berry each turn. At N Berries, heals your most damaged other ally for N.

entries.name: Milling
entries.meaning: Each turn while Ready, you gain N Lumber. It still attacks.

entries.name: Pickpocket
entries.meaning: Its hits steal N tokens from a unit; on the bramble, N of the lowest-ranked resource.

entries.name: Sabotage
entries.meaning: Its hits destroy N of the opponent's resources, lowest rank first.

entries.name: Arson
entries.meaning: Its hits burn N of the opponent's Lumber.

entries.name: Fortification
entries.meaning: On play, builds a N/N Palisade, a Structure, in an empty slot beside it.

entries.name: Spawner
entries.meaning: While Ready, it spawns N N into a free slot beside it every turn.

entries.name: War Banner
entries.meaning: Your other units have +N/+N while it lives.

entries.name: Warcry
entries.meaning: When played, your other units get +N/+N.

entries.name: Shieldwall
entries.meaning: The allies beside it have +N Armor while it lives.

entries.name: Corpsefeeder
entries.meaning: Each turn while Ready, it exiles your oldest graveyard card and gains +N/+N.

entries.name: Amplifier
entries.meaning: The allies beside it have +N on each skill number, up to +N.

entries.name: Stench
entries.meaning: When played, N Stench on the enemy facing it and those beside it.

entries.name: Broodkeeper
entries.meaning: Your units made by abilities arrive with +N/+N.

entries.name: Herald
entries.meaning: Your Leader has +N/+N while it lives.

entries.name: Harbinger
entries.meaning: Whenever another unit dies, on either side, it gains +N/+N (up to N a round).

entries.name: Spotter
entries.meaning: While it lives, your units' attacks, shots and skills can't miss or be dodged.

entries.name: Exhaust
entries.meaning: Its attacks give the target N Exhaust tokens.

entries.name: Hidden skill
entries.meaning: a skill the player has not met yet (SKILL_REVEAL_MAP): shown as a "?" chip until its map is reached

entries.name: Trigger lead: any event
entries.meaning: a custom trigger fires on an event (grey while the card Waits)

entries.name: Trigger lead: On Round Start
entries.meaning: a trigger that fires every round

entries.name: Trigger lead: On Sacrifice
entries.meaning: a trigger on Sacrifice

entries.name: Trigger lead: On Pitch
entries.meaning: a trigger on Pitch

entries.name: Poison tag
entries.meaning: poisons on hit: the bottom-centre pill with the Poison number (the strip also carries a Poison chip)

entries.name: Pitch bonus
entries.meaning: discarding the card gives more than the plain 1 Lumber (the same trophy as Bounty)

entries.name: Poison
entries.meaning: takes N damage at upkeep, then loses 1 stack. Heals don’t touch it; Cure does.

entries.name: Toxin
entries.meaning: takes N damage every round. It never wears off and can’t be cured.

entries.name: Bleed
entries.meaning: takes N damage whenever it attacks or uses a skill; −1 stack a round. Heals remove it.

entries.name: Decay
entries.meaning: at upkeep, takes N damage and loses N Attack.

entries.name: Corrode
entries.meaning: deals N less Attack; loses 1 stack each round.

entries.name: Wither
entries.meaning: loses N max Health at upkeep, and can’t be healed.

entries.name: Exposed
entries.meaning: no hiding for N more rounds: Invisible, Evasive, Smoke and Shadow don’t protect it.

entries.name: Exploit
entries.meaning: N tokens: each hit on it deals 1 more and uses one.

entries.name: Scar
entries.meaning: takes N more damage from every hit.

entries.name: Shocked
entries.meaning: takes 50% more damage from every hit.

entries.name: Staggered
entries.meaning: deals 50% less damage with its attacks.

entries.name: Frozen
entries.meaning: can’t attack, and its Wait doesn’t tick down.

entries.name: Asleep
entries.meaning: can’t act until it wakes; any damage wakes it. Sleep N stacks up to N+1.

entries.name: Paralyzed
entries.meaning: each round, a coin flip decides whether it can act.

entries.name: Stunned
entries.meaning: skips its next attack, and its Wait doesn’t tick that round.

entries.name: Bound
entries.meaning: can’t attack; its Wait still counts down.

entries.name: Webbed
entries.meaning: stuck in a web: it can’t dodge, and it can’t move or be moved.

entries.name: Blind
entries.meaning: each of its swings misses half the time.

entries.name: Tipsy
entries.meaning: swings left, ahead or right at random, and misses if nobody is there.

entries.name: Confused
entries.meaning: half the time, its triggers, skills and actions fail.

entries.name: Smoke
entries.meaning: attacks at it miss 1 in 2 until the end of next round.

entries.name: Petrified
entries.meaning: turned to stone for the round: it can’t attack, and takes half damage.

entries.name: Irradiation
entries.meaning: each round, each token takes 1 Health, Attack or skill point; then 1 token wears off.

entries.name: Shield
entries.meaning: N temporary Health that soaks damage first and doesn’t come back.

entries.name: Invincible
entries.meaning: takes no damage of any kind for N more rounds.

entries.name: Invisible
entries.meaning: attacks and enemy skills can’t find it until it attacks.

entries.name: Silenced
entries.meaning: its skills and triggers are off; its Attack and Health stay.

entries.name: Stymied
entries.meaning: its Wait doesn't count down, so it can't get Ready.

entries.name: Exhausted
entries.meaning: each token makes its next trigger or skill fizzle.

entries.name: Grounded
entries.meaning: a flyer pulled down: no Flying for a while.

entries.name: Stench
entries.meaning: −1 Attack a token, up to −3, until a Wave or the Tide washes it off.

entries.name: Brittle
entries.meaning: counts as Frozen for Shatter, but it still acts.

entries.name: Wet
entries.meaning: takes +1 lightning damage per Wet counter: one for standing in water, one for Rain.

entries.name: Formation
entries.meaning: +N/+N from its allies in line

entries.name: Isolation
entries.meaning: −N/−N, too few allies near

entries.name: Creativity
entries.meaning: no effect yet (reserved).

entries.name: Prayer tokens
entries.meaning: they count toward your Prayer while this unit is on the field.

entries.name: Daunted
entries.meaning: −N Attack until the end of next round

entries.name: Durian
entries.meaning: Thorns +N from the durians it ate

entries.name: Frightened
entries.meaning: it won't attack this round (Haunted)

entries.name: Consternation
entries.meaning: it lost N/N in the hand, for good

entries.name: Berries
entries.meaning: a full basket heals your most damaged other ally.

entries.name: Scavenge points
entries.meaning: every N become 1 Lumber.

entries.name: Salvage points
entries.meaning: every N become 1 Stone.

entries.name: Frozen flakes
entries.meaning: falling frost flakes over the card while it is Frozen

entries.name: Shell plates
entries.meaning: the plates of Shell (armour and temporary Health until the end of next round)

entries.name: Rage shield
entries.meaning: Raging: Attack doubled, half damage taken (a Rage unit below half Health)

entries.name: Heat haze
entries.meaning: a heat shimmer over a fiery card

entries.name: Cage
entries.meaning: the cage round a caged leader (Caged Fight)

entries.name: Guardian plates
entries.meaning: metal plates either side of a Guardian unit

entries.name: Unit light
entries.meaning: a pool of light under a leader, a Light Aura (Illuminate) or Immolation unit; shows at night and in the dark

entries.name: Angel wings
entries.meaning: wings and halo on a Revive unit that is an Angel

entries.name: Phoenix mark
entries.meaning: an ember ring and flame feather on a Revive unit that is not an Angel; goes once the revive is spent

entries.name: Dynamite fuse
entries.meaning: the lit fuse counting down on a Dynamite unit

entries.name: Flyer shadow
entries.meaning: a shadow under a flying (or floating Tide) unit as it hovers

entries.name: NEW! flash
entries.meaning: the first time the player sees this card in a fight

entries.name: Phase spores
entries.meaning: a glow while a unit holds a day/night phase bonus

entries.name: Raining
entries.meaning: rain falls on the battlefield (Wet rules)

entries.name: Sudden death sky
entries.meaning: the late-round red sky of sudden death

entries.name: Wet field
entries.meaning: the field is wet (a Flood or rain) (no CSS rule found)

entries.name: Pitch-black darkness
entries.meaning: Pitch Black / Absolute darkness: the battlefield goes dark and only lit units show (the pointer is a lantern)

entries.name: Terrain
entries.meaning: the battlefield shows its biome terrain (no CSS rule found)

entries.name: Volcanic terrain
entries.meaning: an erupting biome terrain

entries.name: Dark scene
entries.meaning: night or darkness: the battlefield is dimmed and Darkness / Blind rules apply

entries.name: Night pointer light
entries.meaning: at night the pointer carries a soft light

entries.name: Windy
entries.meaning: a strong wind blows: Flyers' wings light up (Tailwind / Headwind) and the wind layer shows
